selection_metric: mean train/CE loss over the final 250M observed tokens
selection_rule: 275M optimal-summary cells require an interior observed best and a valid quadratic fit. Larger sizes are fixed-LR transfer comparisons at the wide-optimal LR and are never reported as hybrid-optimal without an LR sweep.
